title: add vpc control plane provisioning: multi-az subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, peering, Route53 integration
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add first-class support for provisioning the Private Control Plane VPC topology used by on-prem and VPC-private deployments. This PR implements multi-AZ private subnets, interface endpoints (S3, Secrets Manager, ECR, STS), security group rules for control-plane/worker isolation, cross-account VPC peering templates, and Route53 private hosted zone delegation for customer DNS.

Summary of changes: - New Terraform module: modules/vpc-control-plane (multi-az subnets, route tables, NAT, AZ-aware tagging) - Interface endpoints: modules/vpc-control-plane/interface_endpoints.tf (s3, secretsmanager, ecr.api, sts) - Security groups: modules/vpc-control-plane/security_groups.tf with explicit ingress/egress for control-plane ports and egress-only rules for worker nodes - Peering: modules/vpc-peering (cross-account peering routes, optional IAM role for cross-account acceptance) - Route53: route53 delegation and conditional create for private hosted zones + sample records for control-plane service discovery - Helm chart values: templates/values-control-plane.yaml to wire CIDR ranges into installer - Upgrade hooks: upgrade/README.md + terraform upgrade plan that preserves existing endpoints and rotates route53 delegations with minimal downtime

Testing & validation: - Unit tests: terraform validate in CI + tfsec static checks - Integration: created a CI job that runs a full apply/plan against a dedicated test account using small instance types; smoke-tested control-plane services (auth, registry pulls, control-plane API) across 3 AZs - E2E: deployed private installer with the new module to staging, validated cross-account peering acceptance flow and DNS resolution for control-plane.service.internal - Performance: verified no additional latency added by interface endpoints under typical control-plane load

Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implemented and documented - [x] CI validation added (validate, fmt, tfsec) - [x] Upgrade/rollback instructions included - [x] Security review: reviewers validated SG rules and least-privilege endpoints - [x] Linear tasks linked (ENG-4128)

Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main (squash) 2) Run terraform plan in staging and invite infra team to review 3) Gradual apply to production accounts behind a feature-flaged installer workflow 4) Monitor Route53 delegation and peering acceptance metrics for 72h

Rollback: revert to previous module version and re-apply terraform; peering acceptance uses conditional resource so rollback will not auto-delete peer if manual acceptance was used (documented in upgrade/README).

release_notes: Adds Terraform module for Private Control Plane VPC provisioning: multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints (S3/SecretsManager/ECR/STS), security group templates, cross-account VPC peering, and Route53 private hosted zone delegation. Includes upgrade/rollback guidance and CI validation.
notes_for_ops: When applying to production, ensure the peering acceptance IAM role is provisioned in the peer account if using automated acceptance. If customers prefer manual acceptance, set peering_auto_accept = false. Route53 delegation requires updating parent zone records (docs reference). Monitor peering route propagation and resolver rules post-apply.
